theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x ∈ M, t • x ∈ M) → (∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ M ⊆ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ν O) → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → ∀ x ∈ M, x ∈ tangentSpace M x ∧ fderiv ℝ ν x x = 0 ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → tangentSpace M (t • x) = tangentSpace M x ∧ ν (t • x) = ν x ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, t • fderiv ℝ ν (t • x) v = fderiv ℝ ν x v
